Larry King once asked Bill Gates, one of the richest men in the world, what the secret to his success was.

Gates said it starts with luck - being in the right place at the right time. But the real edge, he said, is depth of vision: seeing potential others don't.

Kevin Trudeau was tested on this himself. Handed a matchbook and told to picture it as an acorn, he said, I see a tree. The wealthy man testing him said, I see a forest.

If you can only picture a $25,000 raise, that's the ceiling. Stretch your mind to a million dollars a year, and the $25,000 becomes easy - like a rubber band that never shrinks back once you stretch it.

#kevintrudeau #thinkbig #wealthmindset #successmindset #manifestation #businessmotivation

Kevin Trudeau says most people are like a hot air balloon pilot cranking the heat, confused why they're still not lifting off.

The heat is your effort, your goals, your manifesting - but if the basket is still tied to the ground, none of it matters. You have to untie what's holding you down.

Even then, the balloon rises slowly, because there are still sandbags weighing it down - the counter-intentions, the beliefs that quietly sabotage the goal you say you want.

You need both: the heat of taking action and dropping the sandbags that are blocking you, or you're not going anywhere.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #wealthmindset #yourwishisyourcommand #successmindset #businessmotivation

Kevin Trudeau says fear is almost always false evidence appearing real.

Walk into a dark basement and see something coiled in the corner, and your mind screams snake. Turn the light on, and it's just a rope. Nothing ever changed except what you could see.

That's what he means by enlightenment - not something mystical, just turning the light on so you can finally see what was always there.

Most of what you're afraid of right now is a rope you haven't turned the light on yet.

#kevintrudeau #mindsetmatters #fearless #wealthmindset #successmindset #businessmotivation

Kevin Trudeau says the rich man can learn from the fool, but the fool can't learn from the rich man - because the fool already thinks he knows.

Wise people learn from everyone. Part of his own training was deliberately spending time around people who were struggling financially, not just the wealthy, so he could see the contrast and learn what not to do.

That contrast is what builds discernment: the ability to take something useful from any book, any person, any situation, instead of swallowing it whole or dismissing it outright.

Who's the fool you could actually learn something from today?

#kevintrudeau #mindsetmatters #wealthmindset #successmindset #discernment #businessmotivation
